programme.title: Marsovac: Spasilačka misija
programme.desc: Napeta i inspirativna priča o astronautu Marku Vitniju (Met Dejmon) koji, nakon jake oluje, igrom slučaja ostaje sam i zaboravljen na Marsu, jer je posada mislila da je poginuo. Sa minimalnim zalihama hrane i vode, Mark koristi svoje znanje botaničara i inženjera da preživi na nemilosrdnoj planeti i pronađe način da pošalje signal Zemlji da je živ, dok NASA istovremeno ulaže sve napore da organizuje nemoguću misiju spasavanja.

programme.title: Kakodalogija
programme.desc: Emisija Kakodalogija, autora i voditelja Ivana Stankovića, otkriva šta se zaista krije iza velikih životnih i profesionalnih ostvarenja poznatih ličnosti i traži odgovor na pitanje – kako se postaje uspešan? Kroz jednosatne razgovore jedan na jedan sa ljudima koji su napravili značajne karijere i ostavili trag u svetu biznisa, kulture, sporta i javnog života, Ivan Stanković istražuje ono što često ostaje izvan poznatih biografija – neuspehe, pogrešne odluke, trenutke sumnje, strahove, prekretnice i izazove koji su oblikovali put njegovih sagovornika. Polazeći od jednostavnog pitanja kako da?, Kakodalogija istražuje kako prepoznati pravu priliku, doneti odluku kada nema dovoljno informacija, nastaviti nakon promašaja ili velikog pada i pronaći snagu za novi početak. Kroz konkretna iskustva gostiju, emisija otkriva koliko su na putu do cilja važni talenat i sreća, a koliko upornost, disciplina, hrabrost i spremnost na promene. Kakodalogija tako prevazilazi okvir klasičnog biografskog razgovora i postaje svojevrsni masterclass o životu, karijeri, ranjivosti i donošenju odluka, nudeći gledaocima ne samo inspiraciju, već i odgovore koji im mogu pomoći u njihovim ličnim kako da pitanjima.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Štafeta
programme.desc: Štafeta je emisija Una televizije koja povezuje glasove ljudi iz svih država bivše Jugoslavije, otvarajući prostor za dijalog, razmenu mišljenja i suočavanje različitih pogleda na teme koje nas jednako dotiču. U vremenu kada nas svakodnevica često deli granicama, politikom i različitim interpretacijama prošlosti, Štafeta podseća da region i dalje deli iste emocije, dileme i iskustva. Svaka epizoda donosi jednu centralnu temu – od kulture, muzike i medija do identiteta, društvenih pitanja i života običnih ljudi. Kroz razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima iz Srbije, Hrvatske, Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Severne Makedonije i Slovenije, emisija gradi prostor u kojem svako ima pravo na svoj glas. Štafeta ne traži nužno zajednički odgovor, već iskren razgovor i pokušaj da se region ponovo čuje – bez buke, predrasuda i granica.

programme.title: Tereza
programme.desc: Tereza je lepa i inteligentna devojka koja ne pristaje na život u siromaštvu. Iako je okružena ljubavlju porodice i Marijana, mladića koji je iskreno voli, ona sanja o bogatstvu, luksuzu i društvenom ugledu. Odlučna da sakrije svoje skromno poreklo, koristi šarm i lepotu kako bi postala deo sveta kojem oduvek želi da pripada. Posle ljubavnog razočaranja i poniženja, njena želja za uspehom postaje još snažnija. U bogatom i uglednom profesoru Arturu vidi priliku da zauvek promeni svoj život, ali osećanja prema Marijanu ne prestaju da je prate. Rastrzana između ljubavi i ambicije, Tereza ulazi u mrežu laži, spletki i izdaja, rizikujući da na putu do svega što želi izgubi one koji je najviše vole.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Šangajsko podne
programme.desc: Šangajsko podne je zabavna akciona komedija iz 2000. godine koja spaja divlji zapad i borilačke veštine. Radnja prati kineskog carskog čuvara (Džeki Čen) koji odlazi u Ameriku da spase kidnapovanu princezu. Tamo sklapa neočekivan savez sa brbljivim, lokalnim pljačkašem vozova (Oven Vilson).

programme.title: Terminator 3: Pobuna mašina
programme.desc: U trećem nastavku ovog filma, T-800 je ponovo zaštitnik Džona Konora i njegove buduće supruge. Ovog puta on će morati da ih štiti od ženskog terminatora T-X, još naprednijeg prototipa poslatog da ih ubije.

programme.title: Sibir
programme.desc: Lukas je trgovac dijamantima koji odlazi u Rusiju kako bi gangsteru Borisu Volkovu prodao plave dijamante za koje veruje da mu mogu doneti pravo bogatstvo. Kada stigne u Sibir, saznaje da je čovek iz Rusije kod koga je sakrio dijamante nestao i ubrzo shvata da će morati da ga pronađe ukoliko želi da iz ovog posla izađe živ.

programme.title: Poslednji vitezovi
programme.desc: Pali ratnik se bori protiv korumpiranog i sadističkog vladara kako bi osvetio svog osramoćenog gospodara. Kada korumpirani sveštenik Geza Mot zatraži veće namete od lorda Bartoka, lord odlazi u svoj zamak sa zapovednikom Rajdenom i njegovim vitezovima. Izaziva Gezu Mota i pokušava da ga ubije, ali car naređuje da Rajden lordu odrubi glavu. Oduzima lordu zamak i sve porodične posede. Geza Mot traži od zapovednika da prati Rajdena i na ulazu u svoj zamak gradi gvozdenu kapiju očekujući osvetu. Godinu dana kasnije, lordovi vitezovi traže osvetu zbog nepoštovanja svog gospodara… Klajv Oven, glumac koji je svojevremeno nominovan za nagradu Oskar, fascinantan je u ulozi palog ratnika koji se bori protiv korumpiranog i sadističkog vladara kako bi osvetio svog osramoćenog gospodara – 'oskarovca' Morgana Frimana – u ovoj epskoj mačevalačkoj avanturi koja govori o lojalnosti, časti i osveti.

programme.title: Iznenadni napad
programme.desc: Psihološki triler u kojem se svakodnevni život običnog čoveka pretvara u noćnu moru kada postane meta misterioznih napadača. Glavni junak pokušava da otkrije ko stoji iza napada, dok se bori za svoj život i traži izlaz iz ove smrtonosne igre koja ga vodi ka zastrašujućoj istini.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Alo, Alo! je kultna britanska humoristična serija, koja se u originalnu prikazivala od 1982. do 1992. godine, u devet sezona. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vredna umetnička dela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku Posrnula Bogorodica. Zapovednik grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa je daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je nađe. U isto vreme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran raditi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što uslužuje Nemce. René se takođe trudi da balansira između afera s konobaricama Ivet, Mariom i Mimi i braka sa Idit.

programme.title: Tajne vinove loze
programme.desc: Smeštena u srcu vinogradarskog kraja Srbije, Tajne vinove loze je emotivna porodična saga isprepletena ljubavlju, intrigama i mračnim tajnama. Dve porodice, povezane ljubavlju prema vinu i zajedničkom prošlošću, suočavaju se sa sukobima generacija, rivalstvima i davno zakopanim tajnama koje prete da unište sve što su gradili. Dok se članovi porodica bore za očuvanje porodične časti i nasleđa, kroz njihove priče otkrivaju se strastvene ljubavi, izdaje i lične tragedije. Vinogradi postaju svedoci sukoba tradicije i modernih ambicija, dok prošlost neprestano utiče na sadašnjost.

programme.title: Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Posle očeve smrti, tri sestre – Eleni, Asimina i Droso pokušavaju da opstanu i prežive u malom i izrazito konzervativnom mestu u Grčkoj. Sergios je najmoćniji zemljoposednik i uticajan meštanin koji po svaku cenu želi da oženi sina najstarijom sestrom Eleni kako bi se dokopao njihovog imanja. Ona nevoljno pristaje na ponudu jer zna da je to jedini način da se reše dugova u koje su upale posle smrti oba roditelja. Sestre nisu ni slutile kakva će ih sudbina zadesiti posle takve odluke. U noći venčanja, Eleni i Asimina uprljaće ruke mladoženjinom krvlju sprečavajući ga u pokušaju silovanja njihove najmlađe sestre Droso. Meštani će biti šokirani kada telo mladog, bahatog naslednika bude otkriveno. Tri sestre čine sve kako se istina ne bi otkrila dok svemoćna porodica ne preza ni od čega kako bi pronašla pravog krivca. U tom pokušaju, najmračnije tajne iz prošlosti izlaze polako na svetlost dana i okreću život svima naopačke.

programme.title: Marisol
programme.desc: Ožiljak na licu, buket cveća u rukama i život koji joj nije bio nimalo naklonjen – tako upoznajemo Marisol, junakinju jedne od najvoljenijih meksičkih telenovela svih vremena. Serija koja je devedesetih osvajala milione gledalaca širom sveta od 31. avgusta stiže na Una televiziju, radnim danima u 14.40 časova. U nezaboravnoj ulozi je Érika Buenfil, koja je Marisol pretvorila u junakinju za koju se navija od prvog do poslednjeg kadra. Skromna devojka prodaje cveće na ulici kako bi prehranila bolesnu majku, ne sluteći da je zapravo naslednica bogate i ugledne porodice. Kada se u njen život umeša ljubav, počinje vrtlog tajni, izdaja i velikih preokreta. Sa Hose Andresom prolazi kroz iskušenja koja će testirati njihovu ljubav do krajnjih granica – uključujući i bolnu potragu za sinom koji im je oduzet. Kada je 1996. godine emitovana u Meksiku i širom Latinske Amerike, Marisol je postala pravi televizijski fenomen, a Érika Buenfil zbog ogromne popularnosti serije krenula je i na promotivnu turneju po Latinskoj Americi i Evropi. I danas ova priča ima posebnu publiku – jer neke telenovele jednostavno ne zastarevaju. A znate li ko je Marisolin partner? Eduardo Santamarina – isti onaj fatalni zavodnik kojeg pamtimo kao Alehandra iz čuvene serije Rubí.

programme.title: Rosalinda
programme.desc: Dok služi svoju zatvorsku kaznu, žena dobija dete. Kako bi dobila život koji zaslužuje, dete odlazi da živi sa svojom tetkom.

programme.title: Cvat lipe na Balkanu
programme.desc: Jugoslavija, vreme nakon Drugog svetskog rata. Junaci pokušavaju da zaleče rane koje su nastale u prethodnim godinama i da se prilagode na život u novostvorenoj državi.

programme.title: Una vesti
programme.desc: Una vesti donose najtačnije informacije o najvažnijim domaćim i svetskim događajima – svakog dana u 13 i 15 časova. Nepristrasno, prodorno i brzo novinarstvo, uz lokalni pristup, čini da gledaoci Una televizije budu pravovremeno i pouzdano informisani. Savremene vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i upotreba virtuelne stvarnosti, pružaju jedinstven i dinamičan doživljaj praćenja informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Jedne letnje noći

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 13.30 časova, uz Marijanu Tabaković, Bojanu Bojović i Ivana Vukajlovića, donosi teme koje su deo svakodnevice gledalaca, korisne informacije, stručne savete i razgovore sa zanimljivim sagovornicima. Voditelji se smenjuju u parovima i kroz dinamičan i neposredan razgovor otvaraju različite životne i društvene teme – od zdravlja, porodice i međuljudskih odnosa do svakodnevnih dilema, praktičnih saveta i priča koje zaslužuju pažnju. Uz goste u studiju i priče sa terena, Popodne prati ono što zanima i dotiče gledaoce, u opuštenoj atmosferi i uz mnogo prostora za iskrene razgovore, korisne odgovore i dobru energiju.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 16.30 časova, uz Anu Šupić i Boška Jakovljevića, donosi pregled aktuelnih tema iz zemlje i sveta, razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima i priče reportera sa terena. Poseban prostor posvećen je društvu i kulturi – temama koje pokreću javnost, zanimljivim ljudima i događajima koji obeležavaju svakodnevicu, uz razgovore koji nude različite poglede i odgovore na aktuelna pitanja. Uz poznate ličnosti, priče iz sveta kulture i zabave i muziku benda u studiju, Ana i Boško završnicu dana provode sa gledaocima u prepoznatljivoj atmosferi Popodneva – spontano, neposredno i uz dobru energiju.

programme.title: Gradske priče
programme.desc: Gradske priče su novi serijal Una televizije koji beleži neprolazne priče iz prestonice i drugih delova Srbije. Ovo su priče o stanovnicima gradova Srbije i urbanom okruženju koje ih je takvim napravilo. Teme ove emisije nisu aktuelni događaji, već sve ono što atmosferu grada čini jedinstvenom i neponovljivom. Najstrmija ulica, dan sa čistačem cipela, prva kafana u Evropi, najbolji beogradski đaci, najstariji vozač autobusa, pekara koja postoji 100 godina, žena koja godinama popravlja kišobrane, najteže beogradske škole, najbolji beogradski lekari, mesta za okupljanje, sastanke i rekreaciju, čudesna istorija, robinzoni sa Ratnog ostrva, ljudi sa čudnim hobijima, najlepši beogradski balkon, avanture dostavljača hrane, jutro u samačkom hotelu, dan u birou za izgubljene stvari, kako su nastajale tolike pesme u kojima se spominje Beograd, najduži red za pljeskavicu posle noćnog izlaska, tajna najboljeg beogradskog bureka, cenkanje na pijacama, spokojna šetnja u sred noći - sve je to duh jednog grada u kome svaki ćošak krije priču a svaki prolaznik neponovljivu anegdotu.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Alo, Alo! je kultna britanska humoristična serija, koja se u originalnu prikazivala od 1982. do 1992. godine, u devet sezona. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vredna umetnička dela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku Posrnula Bogorodica. Zapovednik grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa je daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je nađe. U isto vreme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran raditi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što uslužuje Nemce. René se takođe trudi da balansira između afera s konobaricama Ivet, Mariom i Mimi i braka sa Idit.

programme.title: Tereza
programme.desc: Tereza je lepa i inteligentna devojka koja ne pristaje na život u siromaštvu. Iako je okružena ljubavlju porodice i Marijana, mladića koji je iskreno voli, ona sanja o bogatstvu, luksuzu i društvenom ugledu. Odlučna da sakrije svoje skromno poreklo, koristi šarm i lepotu kako bi postala deo sveta kojem oduvek želi da pripada. Posle ljubavnog razočaranja i poniženja, njena želja za uspehom postaje još snažnija. U bogatom i uglednom profesoru Arturu vidi priliku da zauvek promeni svoj život, ali osećanja prema Marijanu ne prestaju da je prate. Rastrzana između ljubavi i ambicije, Tereza ulazi u mrežu laži, spletki i izdaja, rizikujući da na putu do svega što želi izgubi one koji je najviše vole.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Super Indirektno kod Popa i Milana
programme.desc: Emisija Super indirektno kod Popa i Milana donosi uzavrelu sportsku atmosferu! Harizmatični voditeljski dvojac, Milan Kalinić I Predrag Popović Pop, poznat po duhovitim ali I ozbiljnim razgovorima o aktuelnim sportskim temama, predstavlja priče sa različitih terena – indirektno, ali pravo u metu. Ono što ovu emisiju izdvaja jeste neformalna atmosfera studija, koji podseća na prijateljsko okupljanje za šankom, gde dva voditelja u opuštenom razgovoru sa gostima analiziraju najvažnije sportske događaje. Svaka emisija donosi jedinstveni spoj analize, komentara I iskrenih razgovora sa gostima koji imaju šta da kažu I ne plaše se da to I učine. U ovoj emisiji gledaoci mogu da uživaju u diskusijama jednog vatrenog Zvezdaša I strastvenog Partizanovca, koji uprkos sportskom suparništvu uvek uspevaju da pronađu zajednički jezik. U dobroj atmosferi I nesvakidašnjem studijskom ambijentu, sport nije samo tema već I doživljaj!

programme.title: Snajper: Nasleđe
programme.desc: Kada Brendon Beret dobije informaciju da je njegov otac postao nova žrtva nemilosrdnog ubice, koji ubija ljude na visokom položaju u vojsci, kreće njegova osvetnička akcija. Nakon saznanja da je njegov otac ipak živ, shvata da je deo plana svojih nadređenih koji ga koriste kao mamac za hvatanje ubice.

programme.title: Luđački bazeni: Poludimo do kraja

programme.title: Izumrli ili živi
programme.desc: Planinskog vuka s južnog dijela Stjenjaka nitko nije vidio od 1940-ih, no napadi na stoku upućuju na to da on ipak postoji. Forrest kreće u planinu da bi otkrio o čemu je riječ.

programme.title: Kraljevi akvarija

programme.title: Kraljevi akvarija
programme.desc: Pratite ludorije poslovnih partnera, najboljih prijatelja i stalnih suparnika Waydea i Bretta koji vode najveću tvrtku za proizvodnju akvarija u SAD-u - Acrylic Tank Manufacturing.

programme.title: Čovjek za velike ribe

programme.title: Životinjski domovi

programme.title: Teksaški zakon
programme.desc: Lovočuvari Reneau i Stovall sumnjaju da je jedan par nezakonito ubio jelena. Usto, lovočuvar Iles vozi na rehabilitaciju mladunce armadila koji su ostali bez roditelja.

programme.title: Ljudi iz aljaške divljine

programme.title: Projekt grizli

programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal istražuje pozadinu nekih od najneobičnijih policijskih potjera koje su zabilježene.

programme.title: Ubojstvo na južnjački način
programme.desc: Predivna studentica ubijena je u svom domu u Baton Rougeu. Policija se utrkuje s vremenom da bi spriječila serijskog ubojicu da ponovno napadne.

programme.title: Ubojstvo na južnjački način
programme.desc: Na svakom obiteljskom okupljanju zna biti napeto. No kad se dva daleka rođaka počnu svađati, njihova veza završit će se smrću devetoro ljudi.

programme.title: Sjene smrti
programme.desc: U kriminalističkoj, televizijskoj seriji "Sjene smrti" vidjet ćemo kako emocionalni utjecaj ubojstva odjekuje dugo nakon što je zločin počinjen, a neke od posljedica ostaju trajne.

Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Wake of Death
programme.desc: Ben Archer, an ex-mob enforcer, seeks revenge against a ruthless Chinese kingpin responsible for his wife's brutal murder. When Archer joins forces with his old underworld friends, an all-out war is waged against the Chinese Triad.

programme.title: Almost Friends
programme.desc: Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing _ get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: Sharon Maguire's Oscar-nominated romantic comedy, starring Renee Zellweger, Colin Firth and Hugh Grant. As a New Year's Resolution, a British woman seeks to improve her mundane life and decides to go in search of her perfect companion before having a fling with her boss, keeping a diary of her actions along the way. Celia Imrie is among the co-stars.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: Beeban Kidron's romantic comedy sequel, with Renee Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Colin Firth. Bridget is questioning her romance with Mark Darcy when her sneaky boss Daniel returns, and the possibility of an exotic holiday gives her a chance to run away from it all.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Romantic comedy revolving around complicated love life of Bridget Jones. Bridget is 43 and her mom keeps on reminding her that her time to have a child is running out. She goes to attend the funeral of Daniel Cleaver, and there sees her ex, Mark Darcy and his new wife Camilla. At a music festival she has a one-night stand with a very handsome man Jack. At the christening of Jude's youngest child, she meets Mark again and finds out he is divorcing. They realize they are still in love, and spend the night together. A few weeks later, Bridget finds out she is pregnant, and is unsure if Darcy or Jack is the father.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Spirit
programme.desc: A recently bereved father takes his daughter to a new town only to find that their new Victorian house appears to be haunted.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

programme.title: The Prize Winner of Defiance, Ohio
Death Defying Acts
programme.desc: On a tour of Britain in 1926, Harry Houdini enters into a passionate affair with a psychic out to con the famous magician.

programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: The story of Amedeo Modigliani's bitter rivalry with Pablo Picasso, and his tragic romance with Jeanne Hebuterne.

programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: The story of Amedeo Modigliani's bitter rivalry with Pablo Picasso, and his tragic romance with Jeanne Hebuterne.

programme.title: Hit List
programme.desc: Charlotte is a woman with anger management issues whose therapist suggests she write a journal to keep her emotions in check. Unlucky in love, she ventures online to find a boyfriend. Just as she reaches her limit of unsuccessful dates, Charlotte meets her soul mate Lyle. Everything is perfect until Lyle finds Charlottes journal and sets out to prove just how deeply he loves her.

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

programme.title: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Two cop partners, who are also best friends attend a domestic disturbance, only for one to accidentaly critically wound the other. The rest of the police force are suspicious that there may have been no accident.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: Here is a surgeon. He can't practice medicine anymore because he has panic attacks, while reliving a surgery gone bad. His wife is a medical malpractice attorney who picks up a case from a woman who was her husband's nurse.

programme.title: Risen
programme.desc: The Rise of a True British Champion. Based on a true story. As a young man, Howard Winstone was one of the biggest rising talents in amateur boxing. Already with a number of schoolboy titles under his belt, the boy from Merthyr Tydfil, Wales, was fast making a name for himself with his knockout right hand. A career as a professional fighter beckoned. Being from a poor family and struggling to make ends meet, Howard helped out by working weekends in a toy factory. And it was there his dream effectively came to an end as a metal pressing machine malfunctioned and crushed Howard's fingers, injuring his right hand so severely he had to undergo amputation. He lost the tips of three fingers so his right hand could no longer make a proper fist. A depressed Howard seemingly lost everything. But his father wouldn't let him gripe and soon got him punching a coal bag to keep his spirits up. Then, under the guidance of a new trainer, Eddie Thomas, and with the support of his father, he started to learn a new style and once again began to rise up victoriously through the amateur ranks. By the time of his first professional fight, Howard had completely changed the way he boxed. Remarkably, he went on to become Champion of Britain and Champion of Europe. As with any person who achieves great things there is also a cost and Howard's was that of his marriage. At 16 he wed his childhood sweetheart, Bennita, who stood by him and had four beautiful children. But when pressures got too much for both of them the relationship came to a dramatic end. The dramatic finale culminates with Howard exceeding the hopes of an entire nation and being crowned Featherweight Champion of The World.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Crni policajac
programme.desc: Crni policajac gurnut je preko ivice, a svoje frustracije istrešće na privilegovanoj zajednici koju se zakleo da će štititi.

programme.title: Sponzor
programme.desc: Kada muzičarka koja jedva sastavlja kraj s krajem ne može da plati kiriju, prijavljuje se na sajt na kojem bogati stariji muškarci plaćaju da izlaze s mlađim ženama. Novi izvor zarade uvlači je u mračni vrtlog koji je primorava da brzo odraste i menja njenu muziku i pogled na svet.

programme.title: Pravda za sve
programme.desc: Ilajža Kejn, bivši operativac specijalne jedinice i ekspert za borilačke veštine, deo je policijskog tima za tajne zadatke koji često na brutalan način sprovodi zakon na ulici.

programme.title: Mrvica i rudnik zlata
programme.desc: Nakon ponovnog ujedinjenja s porodicom, Mrvica se teško navikava na luksuzan život. Kada ga otme stari neprijatelj, mora upotrebiti najbolje stečeno znanje iz novog i starog života, kako bi pobegao i spasao svoje roditelje.

programme.title: Loša genetika
programme.desc: Žena koja je ostavljena jedanaest puta, otkriva (na svoje zaprepašćenje) da ima gubitničke ljubavne gene.

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi klik
programme.desc: Cinična novinarka dobija zadatak da piše o zavodniku sa dejting aplikacija, ali ubrzo otkriva da se iza njegove reputacije krije mnogo više od onoga što je očekivala.

programme.title: Pravo mesto i vreme za pisanje
programme.desc: Pejdžina majka želi da ćerka krene njenim stopama i preuzme vođenje velikog konglomerata, ali Pejdž želi da bude spisateljica. Kada Džoan odluči da proda izdavačku kuću Atlas zbog manjka klijenata i prihoda, Pejdž to vidi kao priliku da joj pruži poslednju šansu _ ovaj put pišući pod pseudonimom, tako da niko, pa ni Danijel, poslednja nada izdavača, ne zna da upravo njena porodica predstavlja pretnju.

programme.title: Šta sve činimo zbog ljubavi
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Disko
programme.desc: Didje je četrdesetogodišnjak _ fan disko muzike. Muškarac nema posla i još uvek živi sa majkom. Didje ima sina, kojeg dugo nije video, ipak njegova majka ne slaže se da zajedno provedu odmor. Didje odlučuje da pobedi u plesnom konkursu, da dobije nagradu i da povede sina na nezaboravni odmor u Australiju. Muškarac nagovara svoje prijatelje da mu pomognu. Zapošljavaju trenera, koji treba da ih pripremi za takmičenje. Brzo se uspostavlja, da makar nekad bili su odlični plesači, vreme je uradilo svoje. Moraju puno da rade da bi nastupili.

programme.title: Ukradena dolina
programme.desc: Da bi spasila život svojoj majci, meksičko-navaho mehaničarka udružuje snage s odmetnicom kako bi se suprotstavile korumpiranom zemljoposedniku.

programme.title: Nikad neću biti tvoja
programme.desc: Majka započinje vezu s mlađim muškarcem, dok se njena ćerka prvi put zaljubljuje. Ipak, sudbina će tu umešati prste i poigrati se njihovim životima.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Nestala
programme.desc: Kad njena sestra nestane, Džil je ubeđena da se vratio serijski ubica koji ju je kidnapovao pre dve godine. Spremna je da se još jednom suoči s čovekom koji ju je oteo.

programme.title: Tomiris
programme.desc: Tomiris, kraljica Amazonki, povela je 600 godina pre nove ere krvavi rat protiv Persijskog carstva. Kada persijski kralj Kir uništi njeno selo, ona okuplja ogromnu vojsku da oslobodi svoj narod. Slede spektakularne bitke, borbe na život i smrt i spletke surovog kralja koji silom i prevarama želi da pokori narod.

programme.title: Trbosek: Neispričana priča
programme.desc: Detektiv i patolog se udružuju kako bi rešili niz strašnih ubistava u viktorijanskom Londonu _ ali jedan od njih krije smrtonosnu tajnu.

programme.title: Trbosek: Neispričana priča
programme.desc: Detektiv i patolog se udružuju kako bi rešili niz strašnih ubistava u viktorijanskom Londonu _ ali jedan od njih krije smrtonosnu tajnu.

programme.title: Nema šuma
programme.desc: Studentkinja šumarstva Anja Grim dolazi na praksu u šumu u kojoj je njen otac nestao kada je imala osam godina. Dok uzima uzorke tla, otkriva određene nepravilnosti, ali se ubrzo događa brutalno ubistvo. Njena pitanja o zemljištu i prošlosti izazivaju sumnju i neprijateljstvo meštana.

programme.title: Studentsko telo
programme.desc: Srednjoškolka Džejn Šipli pokušava da popravi odnos s najboljom drugaricom Merit i uklopi se među buntovne školske drugove. Kada profesor matematike pređe granicu, a škola na to ostane nema, devojke preuzimaju stvari u svoje ruke, što vodi u haos i smrtonosne posledice.

programme.title: Ti si na potezu
programme.desc: Uspešan njujorški biznismen je na video pozivu sa suprugom i detetom koji su u poseti njenoj porodici u Meksiku, kada iznenada postaje svedok brutalnog napada na njih i otmice. Pošto se ne može osloniti na to da će državni organi sprovoditi zakon, on kreće da pronađe svoju porodicu i osveti se za nasilje koje je nad njima počinjeno.

programme.title: Julije Cezar
programme.desc: Epohalan prikaz Julija Cezara, posljednjeg diktatora Rima, čija smrt je također označila kraj Rimske Republike. Priča o njegovim kampanjama u Galiji i Egiptu, njegovoj rivalstvu s generalom Pompejem i konačnom atentatu pod rukama Bruta i Kasija.

programme.title: Julije Cezar
programme.desc: Epohalan prikaz Julija Cezara, posljednjeg diktatora Rima, čija smrt je također označila kraj Rimske Republike. Priča o njegovim kampanjama u Galiji i Egiptu, njegovoj rivalstvu s generalom Pompejem i konačnom atentatu pod rukama Bruta i Kasija.

programme.title: Julije Cezar
programme.desc: Epohalan prikaz Julija Cezara, posljednjeg diktatora Rima, čija smrt je također označila kraj Rimske Republike. Priča o njegovim kampanjama u Galiji i Egiptu, njegovoj rivalstvu s generalom Pompejem i konačnom atentatu pod rukama Bruta i Kasija.

programme.title: Čovek od poverenja
programme.desc: Priča o Beriju Monkovu, mladom harizmatičnom biznismenu koji postaje imućni direktor i stiže do samog vrha uz pomoć laži, prevara i krađe.

programme.title: Poslednja potera
programme.desc: Godine 1909, Vili Boj i njegova voljena Karlota beže nakon što on u kobnom sukobu slučajno usmrti njenog oca. Dok se predsednik Taft sprema da poseti ovu oblast, lokalni šerif i dvojica indijanskih tragača kreću u poteru za čovekom kog smatraju ubicom svog plemenskog vođe.

programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi
programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi ii sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Satin
programme.desc: Propali pevač iz Las Vegasa, Džek Satin, nema novca, nema posao i u zabludi je da će se proslaviti. Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara, koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstvom.

programme.title: Dženino venčanje
programme.desc: U gradiću u kom je rođena, niko ne shvata zašto se Dženi, najlepša i najpopularnija devojka iz kraja, još uvek nije udala. Kruže glasine da je ljubavnica oženjenog muškarca u "velikom gradu" u kom sada živi, zbog čega nikoga ne dovodi sa sobom na venčanje svog školskog druga. Njeni roditelji očajnički žele da se skrasi. Ipak, Dženina objava venčanja, kada do toga konačno dođe, nije ono što je bilo ko od njih očekivao.

programme.title: Veliki medved
programme.desc: "Big Bear" je priča o Džou, koji nevoljno odlazi na svoje momačko veče iako ga je verenica upravo ostavila zbog nekog tipa.

programme.title: Dobri komšija
programme.desc: Dvojica nestašnih srednjoškolaca uspešno uveravaju svog vremešnog komšiju da u njegovoj kući ima duhova. Međutim, niz nesrećnih okolnosti pretvara njihovu bezazlenu šalu u tragediju.

programme.title: Stanje uma
programme.desc: Očajnički tražeći novi početak, njujorški detektiv Dejvid Seka i njegova trudna supruga beže od mučnog života u Njujorku i vraćaju se u rodni Nju Džersi, gde on nevoljno prihvata posao u lokalnoj policijskoj stanici. Njegovi prioriteti iznenada se menjaju kada naiđe na tajanstveni osmomilimetarski film, slučajno otkriven u starinskoj kutiji za nakit. Stvari se usijavaju kada shvati da je pronašao ključni dokaz koji raskrinkava pozadinu ubistva predsednika Kenedija.

programme.title: Majčino svedočenje
programme.desc: Najcrnje slutnje majke bivšeg robijaša obistinjuju se kada shvati da joj je sin upleten u ubistvo.

programme.title: Valentinin tango
programme.desc: Mračna komedija/drama o ženi koja zbog ljubavi tone u ludilo. Porodica i prijatelji pokušavaju da je spasu, ali bivaju uvučeni u ludilo zajedno s njom. Grčka tragedija sa elementima farse priča o strasti, ljubavi i požudi.

programme.title: Ubistvena igra
programme.desc: Tajni tim ubica pod imenom "Senke", stavljen je na test u igri preživljavanja.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Skoro prijatelji
programme.desc: Čarli, neambiciozni muškarac u srednjim dvadesetim godinama koji i dalje živi s majkom i očuhom i zaljubljuje se u mladu ženu koja je u vezi s ozbiljnim muškarcem.

programme.title: Njuškalo i lov na letećeg fantoma
programme.desc: Rat je završen i selom je zavladao mir. Ali onda, iznenada, tajanstvena prilika u crnom počinje da vreba seljane. Legenda kaže da se ponovo vratio Leteći fantom. Tom, njegova devojka Mirjam i Njuškalo kreću u istragu. Zahvaljujući Njuškalovim posebnim sposobnostima, fantom je uhvaćen u zamku, a zlokobna zavera ubistva i osvete otkrivena je baš na vreme!

programme.title: Njuškalo i ukleti dvorac
programme.desc: Njuškala, nemačkog ovčara, odgajio je Tom. On je psa naučio mnogim posebnim veštinama i sa svojom devojkom Mirjam upada u uzbudljive avanture. Tokom letnjeg raspusta Tom ostaje s Mirjam i Njuškalom kod svog čika Hansa i bratanca Jaapa. Čuli su za ukleti dvorac u susedstvu. Legenda o ovom dvorcu kaže da se u srednjem veku izvesni vitez Betram zaljubio u sluškinju Ejdu, ali je ona već bila zaljubljena u konjušara. Betram rešava da se na užasan način osveti ovo dvoje i od tada se priča da je šuma oko dvorca ukleta. Na putu kroz šumu do dvorca, Tom, Mirjam i Njuškalo prate bandu krijumčara. To ih ponovo vodi u uzbudljivu avanturu…

programme.title: Loša genetika
programme.desc: Žena koja je ostavljena jedanaest puta, otkriva (na svoje zaprepašćenje) da ima gubitničke ljubavne gene.

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri
programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se da održi svoju poslastičarnicu, ali jednog dana izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora primorava je da zatvori posao. Meri sa svojim verenikom Brentom odlučuje da otputuje kod svoje porodice u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću, Brent dobija napad alergije koji ga sprečava da krene na put. Meri odlučuje da sa sobom povede Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca, koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora, i predstavi ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to biti dobra ideja?

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Gorko-slatko
programme.desc: Ekscentrični i bogati trgovac kafom, šalje priznatog stručnjaka u Tajland, gde treba da otkupi novu, egzotičnu vrstu kafe. Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

programme.title: Smrtonosni medeni mesec
programme.desc: Par se venčava na Havajima i za medeni mesec polaze na krstarenje, ali stvari kreću užasno loše.

programme.title: Šta sve činimo zbog ljubavi
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Ljubavnica
programme.desc: Se-jon, vlasnica kafića koja sama odgaja ćerku posle muževljeve smrti, suočava se sa zagonetnim pozivima sa "skrivenog broja". Psihijatrica Eun-su daje sirove savete Jung-von, dok Hva-jong, službenica u advokatskoj kancelariji, prati klijentkinjinog muža i nailazi na nešto neočekivano.

programme.title: Bez očiglednog motiva
programme.desc: Čineći uslugu prijatelju i tražeći odbeglu tinejdžerku, policijski detektiv nailazi na bizarnu grupu kriminalaca koji se spremaju za veliku pljačku banke.

programme.title: Australijski gangster
programme.desc: Luksuzna novogodišnja proslava na brodu loše se završava, što kod Barbarove nove ekipe stvara napetost. Avganistanac optužuje Barbara da je upleten, a jedan od ubica zaduženih za Antonovo ubistvo, još uvek se nije pojavio. Barbaro ga smiruje i govori mu da je njihov posao pri kraju i da će uskoro biti kraljevi grada.

programme.title: The Inspector General
programme.desc: An illiterate stooge in a traveling medicine show wanders into a strange town and is picked up on a vagrancy charge. The town's corrupt officials mistake him for the inspector general whom they think is traveling in disguise. Fearing he will discover they've been pocketing tax money, they make several bungled attempts to kill him.

programme.title: Scarlet Street
programme.desc: A banned box-office hit, Scarlet Street is one of Fritz Lang's greatest American films. Middle-aged cashier Chris Cross rescues streetwise Kitty and tumbles into a spiral of desire, deception, and revenge. As his obsession grows, Chris is seduced, degraded, and transformed, while fate delivers a grimly ironic justice. Featuring standout performances by Joan Bennett and Dan Duryea, the film is packed with sharp twists and masterful direction—a classic, pitch-dark gem of film noir.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programme.title: Answer Me
programme.desc: The love story of a couple which, after the marriage and the birth of the first son, turns into hell. Taken from the novel Rispondimi by Susanna Tamaro.

programme.title: Brides
programme.desc: Nutsa lives with her two small children in suburb of Tblissi, Georgia. With her Goga, they would bee today a regular family if he hadn't been arrested. Between the wedding in prison and the monthly visits, a routine sets in. Wil they be able to overcome this double reality?

programme.title: Go for Broke!
programme.desc: The story of Japanese-American soldiers who fought in Europe during World War II.

programme.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
programme.desc: The rise and rise of the Fabulous Dorsey brothers is charted in this whimsical step down memory lane, Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey play themselves in this vehicle for their excellent music.

programme.title: The Overlanders
programme.desc: It's the start of WWII in Northern Australia. The Japanese are getting close. People are evacuating and burning everything in a "scorched earth" policy. Rather than kill all their cattle, a disparate group decides to drive them overland half way across the continent, from Wyndham in Western Australia through the Northern Territory outback of Australia to pastures north of Brisbane, Queensland.

programme.title: Roaring Abyss
programme.desc: A sound journey accros the mountains, deserts and forests of Ethiopia and its cultural universe. Roaring Abyss will take you through an inedit collection of music recordings of unvaluable importance for the transmission and preservation of the African heritage.

programme.title: The Big Wheel
programme.desc: A brash young midget car race driver lives in the shadow of his famous father, a drunken womanizer, who was killed in an accident years earlier.

programme.title: Outpost in Morocco
programme.desc: Captain Gerard, greatest lover in the Foreign Legion, is assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and find out what he can about the emir's activities. Gerard enjoys his work with lovely Cara, but arrives to find rebellion brewing.

programme.title: Delightfully Dangerous
programme.desc: Young Sherry Williams dreams of having a singing career, and she idolizes her older sister Josephine, who has gone to New York to perform on the stage. When Sherry is distraught just before performing at her school, a visiting Broadway producer encourages her by telling her positive things about her sister. Soon afterwards, Sherry decides to make a surprise trip to New York to visit Josephine _ but what she finds there is not at all what she expected.

programme.title: My Favourite Brunette
programme.desc: Ronnie Jackson is a lowly baby photographer who secretly fantasizes about being a private detective. When a lovely baroness actually mistakes him for one and asks him to help locate her missing husband, Baron Montay, Ronnie finds himself agreeing. Several days later he is on death row whiling away the hours until his execution by recounting to a group of reporters the bizarre tale of how he ended up there.

programme.title: Pot o' Gold
programme.desc: Jimmy goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band who constantly practices.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's a bloodthirsty plant, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: The Sadist
programme.desc: Three people driving into Los Angeles for a Dodgers game have car trouble and pull off into an old wrecking yard where they are held at bay by a bloodthirsty psycho and his crazy girlfriend.

programme.title: The Devil's Nightmare
programme.desc: A group of tourists traveling on a bus take a detour to stay overnight in a castle owned by a family cursed with a history of Satanism and death.

programme.title: The Devil's Nightmare
programme.desc: A group of tourists traveling on a bus take a detour to stay overnight in a castle owned by a family cursed with a history of Satanism and death.

programme.title: Mad Doctor of Blood Island
programme.desc: A man who loves to travel, travels to an island where a mad doctor is creating zombies.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A widow deceives her late husband's mother and brothers into thinking he's still alive when she attends the yearly memorial to his drowned sister, hoping to secure his inheritance, but her cunning is no match for the demented, axe-wielding thing roaming the grounds of the family's Irish estate.

programme.title: Doctor Blood's Coffin
programme.desc: Greta is a beautiful young woman abused by her brother Franz and left to die in childbirth by her illicit lover, the aristocrat Dr. von Ravensbrück. Bereft with grief, Franz reanimates his dead sister using a formula engraved on an ancient Incan medallion. Greta then returns as an undead avenging angel, reaping revenge on the Ravensbrück family and her manically possessive brother.

programme.title: Mrs Aylwood Won't Die
programme.desc: Winter 1969. In an isolated mansion, Susan Aylwood, a former glory of cinema, lives with her housekeeper, the discreet Caroline. Surrounded by her memories, Mrs Aylwood seems to keep a strong hand on her entourage. But what is the terrible truth behind the appearances ?

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: Game Show Dynamos
programme.desc: Bernard and Claire Boiko won enough money on TV game shows to escape debt and rebuild their lives, appearing on national television 28 times from the 1950s to the 1990s. Their daughter Patricia blends clips from 10 game shows with vintage footage, motion graphics, and music to create an intimate portrait of her quirky parents. Through love, hardship, ambition, and humor, the film captures a unique family story and a revealing slice of 20th-century life, culminating in Bernard's words: "If it's a lucky life, it's mine.

programme.title: Black Dragons
programme.desc: A cabal of American industrialists, all fifth-columnists intent on sabotaging the war effort, are methodically murdered by the malevolent Monsieur Colomb.

programme.title: Road Gate
programme.desc: Rauan works at a parking lot in a prestigious residential area. Aidar passes him daily in his luxurious car. The auto belongs to his father, who works in the oil business. Rauan and Aidar are both determined to build their own lives themselves. They live in the same city, their paths cross in the same yard, but there is an abyss between them. They are separated by a toll-bar between wealth and poverty. One day Aidar and Rauan will clash and their worlds will clash. What will the results be..?

programme.title: Revenge of the Zombies
programme.desc: When Dr. Von Altermann's wife Lila dies mysteriously at his spooky mansion her relations suspect murder. They also suspect the doctor is turning her into a zombie, to join the army of living dead he hopes to devote to the Nazi cause. However, Lila, though dead, has developed a will of her own.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: Behind Green Lights
programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Newly appointed sheriff Pat Garrett is pleased when his old friend Doc Holliday arrives in Lincoln, New Mexico on the stage. Doc is trailing his stolen horse, and it is discovered in the possession of Billy the Kid. In a surprising turnaround, Billy and Doc become friends. This causes the friendship between Doc and Pat to cool. The odd relationship between Doc and Billy grows stranger when Doc hides Billy at his girl Rio's place after Billy is shot.

programme.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
programme.desc: Swordsman-poet helps soldier woo the woman he loves.

programme.title: Australia
programme.desc: Friday, 11:00 p.m. Carla, a woman of about forty, is alone in her office. She gets a call, it's Raúl, a young guy who passes her cocaine. They've known each other for some years, but they've never exchanged more than two consecutive sentences. Tonight will be the last night that Raúl works as a dealer. He wants to change his life. He's going to Australia, to work as a gardener.

programme.title: The Terror of Tiny Town
programme.desc: Using a conventional Western story with an all dwarf cast, the filmmakers were able to showcase gags such as cowboys entering the local saloon by walking under the swinging doors, and pint-sized cowboys galloping around on Shetland ponies while roping calves.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dance
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Parysia is the rage of Paris. She has a daughter, secretly engaged to Andre, and the boy's aristocratic father objects to the alliance because of Margaret's mother being a revue artist. Director Ewald Andre Dupont took almost a year to make Moulin Rouge at a production cost of $500,000, a huge amount for 1928.

programme.title: People We Know Are Confused
programme.desc: Set in Vilnius, a modern city still in search for its relation to the past, three parallel stories with three average people marooned in a state of change, looking to the future with hope, but not letting go of constricting and reassuring fears of their past.

programme.title: John Wayne Cold Vengeance
programme.desc: John Wayne burns up the screen in this thrilling tale of vengeance in the Wild West. When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. Little does he know the killer has plans of his own! Featuring a thrilling gun battle with famed Wayne collaborator Yakima Canutt, Cold Vengeance has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

programme.title: The Intruder
programme.desc: A man in a gleaming white suit comes to a small Southern town on the eve of integration. He calls himself a social reformer. But what he does is stir up trouble--trouble he soon finds he can't control.

programme.title: Born to Be Wild
programme.desc: Truck drivers Steve Hackett and Bill Purvis are fired for ignoring company rules, then suddenly hired for a mysterious delivery to Arrowhead with a $1,000 bonus. Told they are hauling lettuce, they soon discover the cargo is dynamite after an encounter with striking farm workers. Joined by Mary Stevens and her dog Butch, they uncover a plot by corrupt real-estate operators to sabotage a dam, ruin local farmers, and seize their land.

programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef
programme.desc: Fierce competition among sponge fishermen forces a Greek-American family to fish in the dangerous 12-mile reef area off the western coast of Florida.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Bride
programme.desc: Hugh "Bulldog" Drummond is on the precipice of matrimony to his beloved Phyllis -- but a bank robbery and a daring escape is going to get in their way before they reach the altar.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Newly married Kay Dunstan announces that she and her husband are having a baby, leaving her father to come to grips with the fact that he will soon be a granddad.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: Romance and suspense ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. Who can she trust?

programme.title: The Lady Refuses
programme.desc: A wealthy London nobleman hires a pretty but poor young woman to distract his playboy son from marrying a golddigger. Complications ensue when the girl and the father begin to fall for each other, and things get even more complicated when the son declares his love for her, too.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: Young Englishman inherits ranch which he wants to sell, but Gene's gonna turn him into a real westerner instead. When new owner Spud arrives from England, Autry convinces him not to sell the ranch but to raise horses for the Army. When both Autry's and Neale's bids are the same, the Colonel calls for a race to decide the winner. But that night Neale has Autry's stable burned.

programme.title: New Voices in an Old Flower
programme.desc: "It was an era, it was the start of a new vision" says Amha Eshete, the first Ethiopian music producer back in the Golden Age, the days of Swingin' Addis. The album releases that have crossed Ethiopian borders are mainly recordings from the 50's to the 80's, however, the contemporary music scene from Addis remains, bar a few exceptions, unknown to the rest of the world. Is Addis still swinging as it used to? Music in Addis is present in actions and sounds spread out on differentiated spaces, it is an expression of the everyday urban life and its processes of transformation and adaptation in the city. New Voices In An Old Flower explores this vitality of music looking at the plurality of the city and its people. Drifting in unplanned tours through the urban landscape of contemporary Addis Ababa, this film is shaped by encounters, dialogues and collaborations with musicians and other inhabitants of the city.

programme.title: Arrest Bulldog Drummond
programme.desc: The invention of an atomic weapon _ a long-range ray that can detonate explosions _ sends Scotland Yard and Captain Drummond into action.

programme.title: The Pilgrim
programme.desc: Disguised as a priest, an escaped convict makes his way to Texas. He ends up in a small rural town where the townsfolk mistake him for their new church minister.

programme.title: The Vanishing Pioneer
programme.desc: A mining engineer teams up with a crusty deputy sheriff to solve the mystery killings at an old mine where the owner's family waits for him to die, and where a valuable radium strike may have been made.

programme.title: 'Neath the Arizona Skies
programme.desc: Chris Morrell, the guardian of half-Indian girl Nina, is helping her find her missing white father. so she can cash in on her late mother's oil lease. Outlaw Sam Black is after the girl and her father as well. Besides dealing with the Black gang, Morrell has to find another robber, Jim Moore, who switches clothes with him after he finds Chris unconscious from a fight with Sam Black. Along the way, he meets a lady who's the sister of Jim Moore, another bad hombre who's in cahoots with Jim Moore, and an old friend who takes in Nina and helps Chris locate Nina's father and fight off the various desperadoes

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Cooling is essential today, but it began with icehouses and lake-cut ice. The "ice industry" faded due to pollution. Air-conditioning was invented to control humidity, not temperature. Cold isn't created—it's moved. The first fridge was built to fight malaria, but early models leaked toxic gases. Even Einstein designed a safer version. Later, refrigerants harmed the environment. Now, scientists explore sound vibrations as a cleaner cooling method.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Every single day there is a growing number of people to feed and in the next thirty to forty years we will need to double our food production to sustain the increase in population. In this episode author Julian Cribb examines the infestations that are threatening our food supply.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Earthquakes have always been with us, but only in recent decades has their devastating impact been captured so vividly on film and online. In this episode, we explore scenes from some of the most destructive natural cataclysms. Of all disasters, none releases more energy than an earthquake—caused when Earth's plates grind and snap, shaking hundreds of square miles. Most occur in the Pacific "Ring of Fire." Alaska sees a 7.0 quake yearly, while California experiences about 10,000, most too small to notice.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he's got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he's brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: For over a year, the staff at Loro Parque have been patiently waiting for a huge event to take place. Morgan, the deaf orca is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The most venomous snake on land. The deserted heart of the Australian outback, where people seldom venture, is the hot, baked home of the most venomous land snake in the world _ the inland taipan, a two meter long snake with enough venom in one bite to kill a quarter of a million mice. Gila Monster _ North America's largest land lizard, venomous and striking, lives in desert regions. Blue-Ringed Octopus _ Tiny but deadly, it carries two venoms—one lethal to humans. Red-Back Spider _ Hidden in messy webs, the female's scarlet stripe warns of her deadly bite. Sydney Funnel-Web _ Aggressive and armed with toxic venom, the male is especially dangerous. Which venomous creature is the deadliest?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Wildebeest & Zebra _ Africa's iconic drifters. No two zebra have the same stripes, even in vast herds. Olive Ridley Turtles _ The world's most abundant sea turtle, migrating vast distances to nest. Sooty Tern _ These seabirds may stay airborne for years before returning to land to breed. Australian Pelicans _ Big-billed birds that follow inland waterways in search of fish. Whales & Whale Sharks _ Ocean giants that roam the seas, some on epic migrations we barely understand. Some of the greatest migratory animals on earth are those that live in its waters and traverse its great oceans. From baleen whales that travel from the nutrient rich polar waters and the whale sharks whose migrations we barely understand.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Tentacles follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin. The episode features the bizarre courtship and never-before-filmed egg-laying rituals of reef squid. Travel to the Pacific Northwest for an encounter with the world's largest Octopus. You'll also witness the fascinating hunting technique of the cuttlefish.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Deserts are dry, extreme places with little rain and few plants. Semi-deserts support more life, but survival is still tough. Animals adapt to heat and water scarcity—some drink rarely, get moisture from food, or travel far for water. Many seek shade, burrow, or are nocturnal. Scorpions, ancient and armored, use pincers and venom to survive. Rattlesnakes, fast and deadly, are feared—except by roadrunners, who hunt them. Desert life demands resilience, cleverness, and unique adaptations

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature's battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim
